independent_solve.reasoning:
The root mean square velocity of gas molecules is related to the pressure $P$ and density $\rho$ of the gas by the formula:
$$v_{\text{rms}} = \sqrt{\frac{3P}{\rho}}$$

Rearranging the formula to solve for pressure $P$:
$$P = \frac{1}{3} \rho v_{\text{rms}}^2$$

Given:
$\rho = 9 \times 10^{-2} \text{ kg/m}^3$
$v_{\text{rms}} = 400 \text{ m/s}$

Substituting the given values:
$$P = \frac{1}{3} \times (9 \times 10^{-2}) \times (400)^2$$
$$P = 3 \times 10^{-2} \times 160000 = 4800 \text{ N/m}^2$$

Thus, the pressure exerted by the gas is $4800 \text{ N/m}^2$.
